hypothesis: Minimal baseline: Standard global intensity thresholding on grayscale establishes an unrefined performance floor.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=False; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: Baseline established: Mean IoU 0.3675, Dice 0.5009. Captures raw egg bodies but suffers from internal holes caused by specular reflections and false-positive background noise.

hypothesis: Specular white highlight glare creates hollow annular masks; morphological closing (7x7) and flood-fill hole filling will eliminate internal cavities and boost recall.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: Morphological hole-filling successfully sealed specular glare holes: IoU surged to 0.3669, Recall improved to 0.6312. Significantly reduces false negatives on egg shell centers.

hypothesis: Unsuccessful Trial 1: Egg shells have chromatic color distinct from neutral gray conveyor; thresholding HSV Saturation (S) channel will isolate egg foreground.
parameters: color=hsv_s; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: Unsuccessful trial 1: Pale beige and white eggs exhibit near-zero saturation identical to conveyor background, dropping IoU down to 0.1773 and recall to 0.3402. Discarded.

hypothesis: CIE Lab decouples lightness L* from chroma; applying CLAHE (clip_limit=2.0) normalizes local contrast across uneven lighting gradients.
parameters: color=lab_l; clahe=True; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: CIE Lab L* with CLAHE normalized illumination gradients (IoU 0.3445), but local contrast enhancement amplified metal roller textures and conveyor grain, slightly lowering precision compared to plain grayscale.

hypothesis: Unsuccessful Trial 2: Local adaptive Gaussian thresholding (block=31, C=4) was tested to determine if local windowing outperforms global Otsu in shadowed corners.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=adaptive_gaussian; fill_holes=True; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: Unsuccessful trial 2: Adaptive Gaussian thresholding created severe contour fragmentation, hollow ring artifacts, and artificial edges across uniform egg bodies, collapsing IoU to 0.3440. Discarded.

hypothesis: Unsuccessful Trial 3: Boundary edge detection via Canny + dilation + hole filling will delineate egg perimeters independently of global illumination.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=canny_edge; fill_holes=True; min_area=none; watershed=False
observations: Unsuccessful trial 3: Canny edge detector suffered from discontinuous perimeter contours under low contrast; subsequent dilation and hole-filling leaked into conveyor background, yielding poor IoU of 0.1439. Discarded.

hypothesis: Conveyor hardware and shadow specks produce false positives. Filtering connected components by single-egg circularity (>=0.25) and area (>=2000 px) will eliminate background clutter.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=2000; watershed=False
observations: Strict single-egg shape priors (min_circ=0.25, min_area=2000) severely clipped multi-egg conveyor trays where touching eggs form composite silhouettes with deep perimeter indentation necks (IoU dropped to 0.2474). Discarded in favor of safe speckle filtering.

hypothesis: Clustered eggs touching each other merge into single silhouettes; Euclidean distance transform with marker-controlled watershed cuts touching contact necks into individual instances.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=300; watershed=True
observations: Distance transform marker-based watershed successfully divides touching egg clusters into distinct instances with minimal binary mask boundary penalty (IoU 0.3540). Crucial for multi-object tracking.

hypothesis: Synthesis of Gaussian blur (7x7), Grayscale Otsu, expanded morphology (7x7 open / 9x9 close), flood-fill cavity repair, and safe speckle filtering (min_area=300) delivers the optimal development set trade-off.
parameters: color=gray_; clahe=False; thresh=otsu; fill_holes=True; min_area=300; watershed=False
observations: Top-performing classical pipeline: Gaussian 7x7 blur, Gray Otsu, expanded morphology (7x7 open, 9x9 close), flood-fill cavity repair, and speckle rejection achieved the best overall balance (IoU 0.3718, Dice 0.5047, Recall 0.6230) in 5.41s.
